Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 18
Reason for Mistake: The Planner miscalculated the lifespans and drew a conclusion that contradicted the verified dates. Antonio Caggiano (30 Jan 1889 – 23 Oct 1979) lived 90 years, while Hardyal Singh (28 Nov 1928 – 17 Aug 2018) lived 89 years. Despite previously acknowledging Caggiano’s ~90-year lifespan, the Planner stated it as ~89 and concluded Hardyal Singh lived longer, reversing the correct comparison.
